fullPassage: Young children write with all their attention focused on each letter. Despite this, it's common for them to write some of the letters backwards. This is called "mirror writing," and it may be caused by the way our brains store images, known as "mirror generalization." When we remember images, we focus on shape rather than orientation. This is because early humans needed to be able to recognize a dangerous predator, such as a tiger, from any angle. Therefore, whether we're looking at a tiger directly or from the side, we still immediately know it's a tiger. It is believed that mirror generalization, combined with a child's weak understanding of right and left, is what causes the occasional backward letter.

③ recognize: 'to be able to recognize' be able to 뒤 동사원형이라 적절합니다.

④ combined: 'mirror generalization, combined with ~' 수동 분사구문이라 적절합니다.
det.tip: with + 명사 + 분사: 명사가 '~되는' 관계면 과거분사. attention focused(주의가 집중된)

questions.passage: Young children write with all their attention focused on each letter. Despite this, it's common for them to write some of the letters backwards. This is called "mirror writing," and it may be caused by the way our brains store images, known as "mirror generalization." When we remember images, we focus on shape rather than orientation. This is because early humans needed to be able to recognize a dangerous predator, such as a tiger, from any angle. Therefore, whether we're looking at a tiger directly or from the side, <u>we still immediately know it's a tiger</u>. It is believed that mirror generalization, combined with a child's weak understanding of right and left, is what causes the occasional backward letter.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 we still immediately know it's a tiger가 시사하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 밑줄 = 방향(정면/측면)이 달라져도 형태로 대상을 즉시 알아본다는 뜻 (거울상 일반화의 예)
det.analysis:
밑줄 문장은 '정면에서 보든 옆에서 보든(directly or from the side)' 여전히 즉시 호랑이임을 안다는 뜻이에요. 앞 문장의 '방향보다 형태에 집중해 이미지를 저장한다'는 내용과 이어져요.

① 매번 두려움을 느낀다: 감정이 아니라 '인식'에 관한 이야기예요.

② 대상의 방향이 바뀌어도 형태로 즉시 알아본다: 방향(각도)이 달라져도 형태 기반으로 알아본다는 거울상 일반화의 핵심을 보여줘요 ←정답

③ 정면에서 본 것만 기억한다: 본문은 정면·측면 상관없이 알아본다고 하므로 반대예요.

④ 위험할수록 느리게 인식한다: 본문은 '즉시(immediately)' 알아본다고 해요.
det.tip: 정면이든 측면이든 즉시 호랑이임을 앎 = 방향 무관, 형태로 인식

ch: 우리는 호랑이를 볼 때마다 매번 큰 두려움을 느낀다.
